results.question: Can SET_CONFIG configure BARCODE input and INTENT output plugins in one intent on DataWedge 15.0?
results.origin: Representative developer question; forum URL not verified

retrieved.text: The programmer's guide directs developers to SET_CONFIG to create or update profiles and configure multiple input, processing, output or utility plugins with a single intent.

retrieved.section: SET_CONFIG / main bundle and PLUGIN_CONFIG BUNDLE
retrieved.text: SET_CONFIG can configure multiple options with one intent. Its main bundle can contain an array of PLUGIN_CONFIG bundles. Each plugin bundle has its own PARAM_LIST. The PLUGIN_NAME is case sensitive. The documented plugin names include BARCODE input and INTENT output.

retrieved.section: Set configuration for multiple modules (full profile) in a single intent
retrieved.text: Support for configuring a full profile with multiple modules, including plugins, APP_LIST and Data Capture Plus, in a single intent started with DataWedge 7.1. Earlier versions required multiple intent calls for multiple modules.

result.response: Yes. DataWedge 15.0 documents multiple PLUGIN_CONFIG bundles in one SET_CONFIG intent; BARCODE and INTENT are documented plugin names. This establishes API support, not success on an untested device.

results.question: On DataWedge 15.0, does SET_CONFIG OVERWRITE preserve unspecified settings in an existing profile?

retrieved.text: CONFIG_MODE supports CREATE_IF_NOT_EXIST, OVERWRITE and UPDATE. UPDATE requires the profile to exist. OVERWRITE resets all options to defaults before applying supplied settings. CREATE_IF_NOT_EXIST updates only specified parameters when the profile exists.

Barcode scanner decode parameter support varies by scanning device. Zebra directs developers to the device-specific Integrator Guide for support details. The SET_CONFIG page alone cannot establish behavior on an unspecified device.
